text:
maria (PM): Hey team — I dropped a slim PRD for the Optimize Toolkit v1 in the docs folder. Needs quick alignment on scope + launch criteria. https://redwood.internal/docs/optimize-toolkit-v1

sarah (ML Eng): skimmed. MVP looks focused: batching heuristics, prefix/KV cache recommendations, quantization presets. good.

ryan (Eng Platform): +1 to scope but we should be explicit about runtime guardrails. we can't ship auto-quantize without model-compat checks.

kevin (SRE): agree. add canary rollout and automated fallback to unoptimized path if P95 latency regresses > 30ms or error spike > 2x.

maria (PM): proposed acceptance criteria in the doc — copying key bits here:
- measurable cost/unit improvement: >=10% token cost reduction on 2 out of 3 benchmark workloads
- no user-facing quality regressions beyond defined thresholds (eval-based)
- SDK + sample notebooks + one customer pilot on Dedicated
- observability: per-route token delta & latency breakdowns available

sarah (ML Eng): for "quality regressions" we need concrete metrics. suggest using eval prompts + embedding-similarity threshold + few NLG evals. set hard threshold: mean BLEU/ROUGE drop <= 1.5% or embedding cosine >= 0.98 on reg test.

deepti (CSE): customer ask: AcmeAI wants sub-token quantization recommendations for Llama-variant + guidance on hallucination tradeoffs. they're pushing for this early. FYI.

maria (PM): noted. proposal: treat heavy model-specific quantization as stretch — include generic 8-bit/4-bit presets in v1, plus docs on where to engage solutions for model-specific work.

ryan (Eng Platform): rollout plan suggestion:
1) internal staging smoke (jobs + infra tests)
2) release-bot create canary flag for 5 partner tenants
3) 25% traffic for 48h with guardrail checks
4) GA after 7 days stable

release-bot: canary flag created: optimize-toolkit-v1.canary -> initial set = [acme, partner-x, partner-y, internal-test1, internal-test2] :white_check_mark:

kevin (SRE): monitoring hooks we need in place before canary:
- token cost delta per route (hourly)
- P50/P95 latency by model variant
- quality regression alerts tied to eval harness runs (nightly)

sarah (ML Eng): edge cases to call out in PRD: multi-turn chats with long KV cache, streaming partial responses (can't batch easily), legal-regulated inputs (PII masking interacts with caching). add acceptance for each.

maria (PM): adding those. also adding an "out-of-scope" list: automatic kernel selection, dynamic model surgery, zero-downtime per-request rewrites.

deepti (CSE): customer-facing docs need a clear "when to use" and "when not to use" section. customers get anxious about hallucination risk with quantized models.

maria (PM): agreed — docs + guided examples (chat vs single-turn generative vs embeddings). I'll author samples.

ryan (Eng Platform): quick config snippet for SDK we plan to ship (for discussion):
```json
{"optimize": {"batching": {"enabled": true, "max_batch_size": 32, "latency_target_ms": 120}, "caching": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl_sec": 300}, "quantization": {"preset": "8bit", "allowed_models": ["redwood/llama-2-13b", "open/oss-model-13b"]}}}
```

sarah (ML Eng): looks fine. ensure SDK exposes a safe-mode flag to force fallback to non-quantized routes.

maria (PM): timeline ask: can we aim for internal beta in 6 weeks, partner canary in 10 weeks, GA in 14 weeks?

ryan (Eng Platform): tight but doable if we keep scope tight. need 2 engineers from runtime + 1 from infra full-time for first 6 weeks.

kevin (SRE): ops checklist created in the doc. I'll link the runbook for rollback steps.

maria (PM): next steps: sarah to finalize acceptance metrics, ryan to finalize rollout automation, deepti to line up Acme pilot, kevin to finalize runbook. I'll incorporate into PRD and request product review by EOD Friday. Thanks! :rocket:
